About this Event

👻🎃 HAUNTED HALLOWEEN – BOLLYWOOD & TOLLYWOOD DJ NIGHT 🎃👻
THE NIGHTMARE BEGINS… 💀🩸
This Halloween, step into a world where the lights go dark, the bass gets louder, and the spirits come out to dance! 👻🔥
MAD ENTERTAINMENTS presents a terrifyingly unforgettable night of Bollywood & Tollywood music, packed with high-energy DJ sets, spooky vibes, haunting visuals, and non-stop dancing. From your favorite Bollywood bangers to the biggest Tollywood hits, get ready to lose yourself in a night where the living and the dead hit the dance floor together! 🕷️🎶
🩸 WHAT AWAITS YOU:
👻 Haunted Halloween atmosphere
🎧 High-energy Bollywood & Tollywood DJ night
💀 Spooky visuals & terrifying vibes
🎃 Halloween costumes encouraged
💃 A dance floor that stays alive until the very end
Come dressed as your darkest nightmare, favorite horror character, creepy creature, ghost, vampire, or anything that makes people scream! 🧛‍♂️🧟‍♀️👹
Gather your crew, bring your best Halloween energy, and prepare for a night filled with music, madness, mystery, and mayhem.
⚠️ ENTER IF YOU DARE…
Once the lights go down, there’s no telling what—or who—you’ll encounter.
THE DEAD ARE READY TO DANCE. ARE YOU? 👻💀🔥
